corrections.text: The article states that the sources read contain no independent evaluation of the models. The blog post's comment thread includes an informal fine-tuning test by a Hugging Face user, Tom Aarsen, who writes that "a UltraBERT-150M finetuned as a dense embedding model outperforms e.g. ModernBERT-large (~400M) and Ettin-400M finetuned in that same way." It is a single comment on a 32k-triplet MS MARCO run, not a formal evaluation, and the article's other benchmark figures remain the authors' own.
